messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Hindi, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Hindi line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
तब डर थोड़ा शांत हुआ, जो मेरे हृदय के सरोवर में मुझसे टिकी थी वह रात जिसे मैंने अत्यंत दया के साथ पार किया।

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation (Hindi → Eng) | Status | |-------------|-----------------------|----------------------|--------------------------------|--------| | Allor | temporal adverb “then” | तब | “then” | OK | | fu | copular verb “was” (past) | हुआ | “became/was” | OK | | la (1) | definite article (fem.) | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | paura | noun “fear” | डर | “fear” | OK | | un | indefinite article (masc.) | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | poco | adverb of degree “a little” | थोड़ा | “a little” | OK | | queta | adjective “quieted” | शांत | “quiet” | OK | | che | relative pronoun “which/that” | जो | “which/that” | OK | | nel | preposition + article “in the” | में | “in” | OK | | lago | noun “lake” | सरोवर | “lake” | OK | | del | preposition + article “of the” | के | “of” | OK | | cor | noun “heart” (poetic) | हृदय | “heart” | OK | | m'era | clitic + auxiliary “to me was” (pluperfect) | मुझसे | “to me” | OK | | durata | past participle “had lasted” | टिकी थी | “had lasted” | **WRONG** (semantic mismatch; “टिकी थी” means “stuck”, not “lasted”) | | la (2) | definite article (fem.) | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | notte | noun “night” | रात | “night” | OK | | ch'i' | relative pronoun “that” (elided) | जिसे | “that (whom)” | OK | | passai | verb “I passed” (remote past) | पार किया | “passed (through)” | OK | | con | preposition “with” | के साथ | “with” | OK | | tanta | adjective “so much” (degree) | अत्यंत | “extremely/so much” | OK | | pieta | noun “pity” | दया | “pity/compassion” | OK |
### Items Needing Attention - **WRONG:** `durata` → “टिकी थी” does not convey the intended meaning “had lasted”. A more accurate rendering would be “रही थी” or “स्थायी थी”. - **UNNECESSARY:** Articles `la` (both occurrences) and `un` are naturally omitted in Hindi; their absence is acceptable.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Hindi script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Hindi text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- **Line 19** - Original: तब डर थोड़ा शांत हुआ, - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
- **Line 20** - Original: जो मेरे हृदय के सरोवर में मुझसे टिकी थी - Issue: **WRONG** – “टिकी थी” does not convey “had lasted”; **GRAMMAR** – gender/tense mismatch. - Corrected: जो मेरे हृदय के सरोवर में मुझसे रहा था
- **Line 21** - Original: वह रात जिसे मैंने अत्यंत दया के साथ पार किया। - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
